MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_FORTE.title: Forte
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_FORTE.description: Improves the effects of AttackNote, SkillNote, and PowerNote.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_START.title: Starting
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_START.description: Triggers when all Note slots are empty.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_END.title: Ending
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_END.description: Triggers when exactly one Note slot is empty.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PERFORMANCE.title: Performance
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PERFORMANCE.description: Played at the start of the next several turns.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY.title: Starry
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY.description: Generates a StarryNote instead of the Note matching the card's original type. A StarryNote grants [img]res://MGRMod/images/characters/energy_text.png[/img].
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_BASIC_NOTES.title: BasicNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_BASIC_NOTES.description: AttackNote, SkillNote, PowerNote, StatusNote, and CurseNote correspond to the five basic card types.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_NOTE.title: AttackNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_NOTE.description:
Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
Each [gold]Forte[/gold] increases this damage by 2.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_SKILL_NOTE.title: SkillNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_SKILL_NOTE.description:
Gain 1 Block.
Each [gold]Forte[/gold] increases this Block by 1.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_POWER_NOTE.title: PowerNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_POWER_NOTE.description:
Draw 1 card.
For every 2 [gold]Forte[/gold], draw 1 additional card.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STATUS_NOTE.title: StatusNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STATUS_NOTE.description:
Apply 1 Weak and Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
Unaffected by [gold]Forte[/gold].
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CURSE_NOTE.title: CurseNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY_NOTE.title: StarryNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_GHOST_NOTE.title: GhostNote
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.title: Chord
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.description: Triggers when all Note slots are filled, resolving every Note.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_OMNIA_NOTE.title: Omnia
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_OMNIA_NOTE.description: Has the effects of AttackNote, SkillNote, PowerNote, StatusNote, CurseNote, and [color=#b96cff]StarryNote[/color].
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_EMPTY_NOTE_SLOT.title: Empty Note Slot
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_EMPTY_NOTE_SLOT.descript:
Whenever you play a card, generate the corresponding [gold]Note[/gold] based on its type.
When all Note slots are filled, trigger a [gold]Chord[/gold] and resolve every Note.
